items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: I said, all right, so that's where I'll play that next job with them boys that Saturday. And I told them that I was going to go with Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Did he stutter all the time? All the time studied. Yes he studied.

Maybe somebody told me. Yes he did. He studied all the time. He said I want you to bring me to the man's house. I want some money. All right. He gets on there and said come on we're going to the man's house. I said we got him in the car and went on down to the man's house. I mean he went to the man's and knocked at the door. Man said who was that? Buddy Petit. So man said what you want buddy? I want some money. So that's where the man said I told you I didn't have no money buddy. Yeah. So he came down and he…
Where did he live when he lived over here in the city?
